identificationModule.briefTitle: A Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of SI-B001 in the Treatment of Recurrent and Metastatic HNSCC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of SI-B001 in the Treatment of Recurrent and Metastatic Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This multi-center, open label phase II clinical study is performed in patients with recurrent metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck progressed on prior anti-PD-1 mab ± platinum-based chemotherapy. This study is investigating the safety and efficacy of SI-B001 as a single agent in patients.

conditions: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

armGroups.label: Study treatment
armGroups.description:
SI-B001 is a bispecific antibody targeting EGFR and HER3, which is administered weekly by intravenous infusion（QW）.

The 4-week cycle was maintained until disease progression or cessation due to intolerable toxicity or other reasons (e.g., withdrawal of informed consent or death). From C1D1, efficacy was evaluated every 8 weeks ±7 days in the first year and every 12 weeks ±7 days in the second year.
